tests.name: Python regressions, launcher and archive contracts

additional_checks: Branding, accessible home link, guide, footer and exact MIDI/WAV filenames verified in Edge
Header fit verified at 1440, 1024, 768, 390 and 320 px
Windows native executable built using tools.build_desktop
Packaged executable smoke checks with free port and occupied default port
Windows ZIP checksum, executable identity, quickstart and entry names verified
limitations: Local native build and packaged runtime verification were performed on Windows x64. Linux and both macOS targets use the updated CI workflow and were not executed locally.
No tagged release was published. Existing downloaded executables and historical release assets retain their previous names.
Historical verification reports, source generators for those historical reports and captured evidence keep the Prima branding present at the time.
Browser layout verification covered the app's sole available English interface. It does not certify other browser engines or operating systems.
